newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hanover airport to open third terminal in June '98.
newsitem.headline: Hanover airport to open third terminal in June '98.

text.p: Hanover airport said it will double passenger capacity with the opening of a third passenger terminal in June 1998.
The 269 million mark ($156.1 million) charter traffic terminal would increase total airport capacity to eight million passengers a year, an airport authority statement said.
A 90 million mark heavy rail S-Bahn line connecting the airport to the city centre would open ahead of the Expo 2000 world exhibition when the airport planned to receive 6.5 million passengers.

Passenger numbers at Hanover airport rose 4.3 percent to a new record of 4.3 million last year while air cargo grew 12.7 percent to 11,247 tonnes. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
